messages:
incident-bot: Pager: S1 - Outbound notifications failing for multiple customers. Error rate > 60% on Twilio SMS and SendGrid email v1 API. Triggering on-call. https://status.twilio.com/incident/abcd, https://status.sendgrid.com/incidents/xyz :rotating_light:
oncall-alex: I’m taking this. seeing 5xx and 429 spikes in the webhook logs. Impact: verification codes and transactional emails failing. Paging SRE.
sre-lee: on it. pulling logs now. can you post request ids + example errors?
support-maya: help queue spiking. ~120 open tickets mention "verification code" or "no email". Customers: fintech onboarding flows and auth verification.
eng-frontend-sam: we have feature flag `use_fallback_sms` — flipping to on to stop blocking new signups while we investigate. will post when done.
oncall-alex: go ahead and flip, include a 90s retry window before fallback to email. inform CS.
eng-frontend-sam: done. `use_fallback_sms=true` -> now. pushing a small hotfix to prefer email fallback for users without SMS. deploy-bot: Deploy 2026-03-15T14:12Z started by eng-frontend-sam.
sre-lee: confirmed Twilio API returning 503 / 524 gateway timeouts for outbound messages. SendGrid showing 5xx on some US endpoints and rate-limit 429 on EU. Collating error samples: `HTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable`, `HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests` with Retry-After: 120.
incident-bot: Added incident severity S1. Notifying execs and support on-call rotation.
customer-success-anna: Could we send an in-app banner for affected orgs explaining delays? That's lower blast risk than emails.
support-maya: Agree. Drafting templates to send to impacted customers via in-app + support messages. Will hold mass email.
oncall-alex: Action list: 1) fallback toggle (done) 2) start queued retries with backoff 3) limit new verification flows to email-only for high-failure regions 4) contact vendors and update status page 5) customer comms via in-app/support
sre-lee: I've opened vendor tickets: Twilio incident ID TW-2026-0315-01, SendGrid incident ID SG-2026-0315-A. They acknowledge increased errors and are investigating. Twilio suggests some carrier throttling downstream.
eng-frontend-sam: enabling local queue: `notifications.queue.enabled=true` and backoff policy `retry: exponential, max_attempts:5`. Pushing now.
eng-frontend-sam: queue enabled. starting replay of failed messages slowly (rate 2/s) to avoid triggering vendor rate-limits.
oncall-alex: support, please prioritize customers on Dedicated plans and auth-critical flows for manual outreach.
support-maya: on it. outreach list generated, DMing CS for handoffs.
product-jordan: estimate user-visible impact window? if vendors take > 1 hour we'll need broader comms.
sre-lee: current projection per vendor: Twilio investigating, unclear ETA. SendGrid showing partial recovery in EU. I'll update every 10 minutes.
incident-bot: Reminder: if incident exceeds 2 hours, we'll spin up cross-functional bridge.
customer-success-anna: We should prepare a KB article for customers about verification fallback and how to re-trigger codes. Drafting now.
eng-frontend-sam: note: some customers will see duplicate emails when we replay — adding dedupe by external_message_id for 24h window.
sre-lee: monitoring shows queued replay success rate ~70% so far. Downstream errors still occasional 503s.
support-maya: first wave of priority customers notified via in-app. Templates used: "We’re aware of delayed verification SMS/emails; please use 'resend code' in-app. We're working with providers".
oncall-alex: update from Twilio: they're seeing carrier propagation issues, recommend retry with backoff; no immediate ETA. SendGrid: applied rate-limiting mitigation; partial recovery but still elevated errors for some customers.
product-jordan: decision point: if Twilio doesn't stabilize in next 30m, enable alternative provider (experimental) for SMS for Dedicated customers? Risky but needed for auth-critical flows.
sre-lee: I can stand up a temporary route to the backup provider for specific customer IDs. Need API keys and a quick mapping layer. eng-frontend-sam can wire it.
eng-frontend-sam: I have the integration for Bandwidth (backup) in a feature branch. can enable a scoped switch for Dedicated customers. Will require config update and a small restart of notif-worker.
oncall-alex: proceed for Dedicated/auth-critical only. document changes in the incident thread and get CS signoff first.
customer-success-anna: CS approves targeted switch for 3 enterprise customers impacted.
eng-frontend-sam: switching routing for customer IDs [acct_9, acct_42, acct_77] to `bandwidth` now. Restarting notif-worker.
deploy-bot: Restarted notif-worker service (rev 23.4.1) by eng-frontend-sam at 2026-03-15T14:28Z.
sre-lee: routing change successful, those accounts seeing SMS delivery now. Monitoring for duplicates.
support-maya: tickets for those accounts updated. customers confirmed SMS code received.
incident-bot: Update: 30m elapsed. continue monitoring and vendor updates every 10m.
oncall-alex: next steps: continue replay at limited rate, CS to escalate any enterprise issues, SRE to prepare postmortem outline, product to evaluate longer-term multi-provider routing for critical flows.
product-jordan: noted. will queue a roadmap item for multi-provider routing + better health-based failover.
sre-lee: vendors provided post-incident contact channels. collecting all request IDs and logs. Will gather error histograms for postmortem.
customer-success-anna: KB draft done. sharing in #support-docs for review.
support-maya: help queue trending down after fallback and targeted routing. current new ticket rate ~18/hr (from 120 peak).
oncall-alex: final status for now: degraded but largely mitigated for priority customers; broad recovery dependent on Twilio/SendGrid resolution. I'll keep this thread live until both vendors report full recovery.
incident-bot: Incident S1 remains open. Next update in 10 minutes.
